description: II-07: on a dynaset over T, the raw shapes of Bookmark, LastModified with no modification, GetRows(2) and GetRows(); CacheSize put/get, FillCache and CacheStart; PercentPosition get, put 50 and AbsolutePosition; Move(-1) from the first row with BOF, Move(100) with EOF. A held Field V across MoveFirst, MoveNext, a failing FindFirst('ID = 999') with NoMatch, and Requery. Recordset.OpenRecordset after Filter 'ID > 2' and after Sort 'V DESC', each read. Then dbOpenDynamic on T, and Errors.
